objective_for_doctor:
Age: 52
Sex: Male
Chief Complaint: I have right side of the chest pain, left side of the chest pain, and right posterior chest wall pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I have severe chest pain on both sides—more like a sharp “knife-stroke” pain—and also pain in the right posterior chest wall. I’m very short of breath, I get pain when I breathe in (pleuritic), and my left calf is swollen.
[ASK] Do you have **sudden onset pleuritic chest pain** (worse with breathing) or **sudden shortness of breath**?
Yes—my chest pain is sudden and it’s worse when I breathe in. I’m also suddenly very short of breath.
[ASK] Do you have sudden, sharp chest pain that is worse when you breathe in (pleuritic pain) and/or sudden shortness of breath?
Yes. It’s sudden sharp pain and it gets worse with breathing in, and I’m also suddenly very short of breath.
I don’t know the cause—I’m not diagnosed with anything yet. But I do have severe pleuritic chest pain, sudden shortness of breath, and my left calf is swollen.

I can’t say what exact diagnosis it is. I’m just telling you my symptoms: sudden sharp chest pain worse with breathing, sudden shortness of breath, and swelling in my left calf, plus I had surgery within the last month and I have active cancer.
